props.name: dataLabelPosition

props.description: Prints the values on the chart (percentages on pie and donut slices).
props.name: dataLabels

props.description: Uncontrolled initial hidden series.
props.name: defaultHiddenSeries

props.description: Uncontrolled initial selection.
props.name: defaultSelectedDataPoints

props.description: Uncontrolled initial zoom.
props.name: defaultZoomRange

props.description: Legend items are plain labels: clicks don't hide series.
props.name: disableLegendToggle

props.description: Markers on single points (`{ seriesIndex, dataPointIndex, color, size, shape }`), also on series without markers.
props.name: discreteMarkers

props.description: Donut hole in % of the radius (10 to 95). Default 72.
props.name: donutSize

props.description: Sankey charts: link opacity (0 to 1). 4.
props.name: edgeOpacity

props.description: Sankey charts: the links (`{ source, target, value, color }`, node ids).
props.name: edges

props.description: Pie, donut and radial bar: end angle in degrees. Default 360.
props.name: endAngle

props.description: Area fill. `"solid"`, or `"pattern"`: bars, areas and slices get a different pattern per series (or `fillPattern`).
props.name: fill

props.description: Pattern of every bar, area and slice (turns patterns on): `"slantedLines"`, `"squares"`, `"circles"`, `"horizontalLines"` or `"verticalLines"`. Series may set `fillPattern`.
props.name: fillPattern

props.description: Grid lines: `"y"` (default) horizontal, along the value ticks (between the bars of horizontal bar charts); `"x"` vertical; `"both"` or `"none"`.
props.name: grid

props.description: Stripes between the vertical grid positions: colors in turn.
props.name: gridColumnColors

props.description: Opacity of the column stripes (0 to 1). 5.
props.name: gridColumnOpacity

props.description: Stripes between the horizontal grid lines: colors in turn (palette names, `"grey"` or `"transparent"`).
props.name: gridRowColors

props.description: Opacity of the row stripes (0 to 1). 5.
props.name: gridRowOpacity

props.description: Synchronized charts: charts of one group share the active category and the zoom.
props.name: group

props.description: Plot height in px. Default 320.
props.name: height

props.description: Controlled: indexes of the series (pie, donut, radial bar: categories) hidden through the legend.
props.name: hiddenSeries

props.description: Waterfall charts: no dashed lines from the end of each bar to the next one.
props.name: hideConnectors

props.description: Bars run left to right, categories down the side.
props.name: horizontal

props.description: Stock charts: indicators of the first series (the price), such as `{ type: "sma", period: 20 }`. Overlays (`sma`, `ema`, `bollinger`, `vwap`, `donchian`, `keltner`) draw over the price; `volume`, `rsi`, `macd`, `stochastic`, `atr`, `cci` and `pvt` get a pane each.
props.name: indicators

props.description: Accessible name of the chart and the caption of its data table.
props.name: label

props.description: Replaces the x text in axis labels, the tooltip title and the table.
props.name: labelFormatter

props.description: Never shown for a single series.
props.name: legend

props.description: Legend items line up `"left"`, `"center"` or `"right"` (default right above the plot, centered below it).
props.name: legendAlign

props.description: Legend items show a value: the slice's or ring's, or the series' last one.
props.name: legendValues

props.description: Locale of numbers and month names.
props.name: locale

props.description: Localized texts: part labels ("Minimum", "Q1"…), tool names, the export error and `selected`.
props.name: localeText

props.description: Marker shape of every series: `"circle"` (default), `"square"`, `"triangle"`, `"diamond"`, `"cross"`, `"plus"` or `"star"`. Series may set `markerShape` themselves.
props.name: markerShape

props.description: Marker radius of line and area points in px (default none; scatter 5).
props.name: markerSize

props.description: Stock charts: a navigator under the chart (the whole price line, the zoom as a brush).
props.name: navigator

props.description: Sankey charts: node thickness along the flow in px. Default 20.
props.name: nodeWidth

props.description: Sankey charts: node titles and colors (`{ id, title, color }`); nodes without links aren't drawn.
props.name: nodes

props.description: Called when the active category or point changes (pointer, touch or keyboard).
props.name: onActiveChange

props.description: Called for each point a click, Enter or Space selects or clears, with the point, whether it is selected now and every selected point (ApexCharts' `dataPointSelection`).
props.name: onDataPointSelection

props.description: Called with the new hidden series when a legend item is toggled.
props.name: onHiddenSeriesChange

props.description: Called with the new zoom: the chart's own gestures (`"user"`), its group or a brush.
props.name: onZoomRangeChange

props.description: Sankey charts: the flow runs left to right (default) or top to bottom.
props.name: orientation

props.description: Stock charts: height of each indicator pane in px. Default 120.
props.name: paneHeight

props.description: Controlled: the selected points (`{ seriesIndex, dataPointIndex }`). A click selects the point, slice or cell under the pointer, Enter or Space the active one.
props.name: selectedDataPoints

props.description: Series: values per category, `[x, y]` pairs (scatter, dates) or `{ x, y, color }`. Every type but `sankey` (which takes `nodes` and `edges`).
props.name: series

props.description: Shows the legend for a single series too.
props.name: showForSingleSeries

props.description: No axes, grid or legend: the chart fills its container (cards, table cells). Its height is the container's, at least `height` (default 40px).
props.name: sparkline

props.description: Stacked mixed charts: only the bar series stack; lines and areas keep their own values.
props.name: stackOnlyBar

props.description: Stacked bars: prints the total of each stack past its end.
props.name: stackTotals

props.description: Stacked charts: `"normal"` (default) stacks the values; `"100%"` stacks each category's values as shares of their total, on a value axis from 0 to 100%. Tooltips keep the values.
props.name: stackType

props.description: Stacks the series on each other (bars, lines, areas).
props.name: stacked

props.description: Pie, donut and radial bar: start angle in degrees, clockwise from 12 o'clock. Default 0.
props.name: startAngle

props.description: Line width of every series in px. 5. Series may set `strokeWidth`.
props.name: strokeWidth

props.description: A toolbar with zoom buttons (with `zoom`) and downloads (SVG, PNG, CSV).
props.name: toolbar

props.description: Tooltip. every series of the category. `"point"`: only the value under the pointer or the keyboard. `"none"`: no tooltip is shown, but the values the keyboard moves to are still announced.
props.name: tooltip

props.description: Custom tooltip content: called with the title, the rows (name, value, color), whether the item is selected and its data points; returns what the tooltip shows.
props.name: tooltipContent

props.description: The tooltip stays in this corner of the plot instead of following the value.
props.name: tooltipFixed

props.description: Donut and radial bar center: the total (default the sum; radial bars the average).
props.name: total

props.description: Donut and radial bar center: the label of the total ("Total"); no total without it.
props.name: totalLabel

props.description: Radial bar track thickness in % of the bar. Default 50.
props.name: trackWidth

props.description: `area`, `bar` (columns; rows with `horizontal`), `scatter`, `pie`, `donut`, `radialBar` or `radar`. Pie, donut and radial bar draw the first series, one slice or ring per category.
props.name: type

props.description: Replaces the value text in the tooltip, the table and the value axis (`series` -1).
props.name: valueFormatter

props.description: Text before every value ("$").
props.name: valuePrefix

props.description: Text after every value ("%").
props.name: valueSuffix

props.description: Waterfall charts: color of the steps that lower the total.
props.name: waterfallNegativeColor

props.description: Waterfall charts: color of the steps that raise the total.
props.name: waterfallPositiveColor

props.description: Waterfall charts: color of the subtotal bars (`isSubtotal` points). Default the total color.
props.name: waterfallSubtotalColor

props.description: Waterfall charts: color of the total bars (`isTotal` points). Default the series color.
props.name: waterfallTotalColor

props.description: Header of the data table's first column.
props.name: xLabel

props.description: Title of the x axis, drawn under its labels (also the data table's first header by default).
props.name: xTitle

props.description: (`"numeric"` for scatter).
props.name: xType

props.description: Highest value on the value axis; radial bars: the value of a full ring (default 100).
props.name: yMax

props.description: Lowest value on the value axis (default from the data).
props.name: yMin

props.description: Title of the value axis.
props.name: yTitle

Each takes `seriesName`, `opposite`, `logarithmic`, `logBase`, `reversed`, `tickAmount`, `min`, `max`, `title` and `show`. Series without a `seriesName` match go to the axis at their position.
